item.title: Apple’s MacBook Neo is $599? Whoa.
item.description: Macworld Apple on Wednesday introduced the MacBook Neo, a new addition to the MacBook line. Priced at $599/£599, the MacBook Neo is the lowest-priced laptop that the company offers–it’s $500/£500 lower than the MacBook Air, following that device’s sort-of price rise yesterday. That’s a considerable difference. To get to such a low price point, the MacBook Neo features a number of compromises compared to its pricier brethren. item.title: MacBook Neo: Everything you need to know about the new budget Mac
item.description: Macworld The MacBook Neo is a new laptop from Apple that is sure to be a big hit because it comes in at a much lower price than the MacBook Air, starting at $599/£599 compared to the MacBook Air’s $1,099/£1,099. item.title: macOS 26 Tahoe Guide: New features in the latest macOS 26.3.1 update
item.description: Macworld Like its counterparts on the other Apple devices, in September 2025 macOS got a brand new look along with a new name: macOS 26. Because Apple is aligning the names of all the operating systems this year, the new version of macOS is called macOS 26 rather than macOS 16. It also takes the name Tahoe, inspired by the lake, beaches, and the ski resorts of that area of California. item.title: The toughest MacBook Neo decision is a $100 button
item.description: Macworld Apple’s new MacBook Neo is an eye-catching $599/£599, but to reach that price point, Apple had to make numerous compromises and sacrifices. item.title: Apple March event live blog: Every new product as it happens
item.description: Macworld Aside from the launch of the AirTag 2 last month, it had been a quiet year for Apple so far.
